notes: Hotfix: adminViolationMenuButtonsHtml (and updateAdminView's active-toggle loop, both in assets/js/checklist/phf-checklist-app.js) computed the Ghi nhan loi/Nhat ky loi sidebar active state from violationEffectiveView(path,true) alone, without first checking adminViewFromPath(path)==='violations'. Since violationEffectiveView defaults to 'create' whenever the URL carries no view/workflowStatus param - true on every other admin page - 'Ghi nhan loi' lit up as active on Tong quan, Bao cao, Nhan su, etc. alongside the real active item. Both call sites now only resolve effView (and therefore only allow a match) when the current admin view actually is 'violations'; everywhere else effView is '' so neither button gets the active class. Manager sidebar (violationItem) already had this guard (active==='violations'&&...) and was unaffected. UI-only, no router/permission/workflow/KPI/backend change.
